query: Clacton by-election August 2026 Nigel Farage candidates contesting - which parties standing aside, who is running against him, full candidate list
answer:
I've completed the research on the Clacton by-election. Here's a summary of the key findings:

**The by-election:** Scheduled for **Thursday 13 August 2026**, triggered by Nigel Farage's resignation (announced 7 July, accepted 8 July 2026) amid parliamentary scrutiny of his finances — reportedly a £5m payment from crypto investor Christopher Harborne allegedly not properly declared. Farage denies wrongdoing.

**Record field:** A **record 34 candidates** are standing — the most in any UK parliamentary election in history.

**Parties standing aside (5):** Labour, Conservatives, Liberal Democrats, Greens, and Restore Britain are all boycotting, variously calling it a "stunt," "fake/ego by-election," and "Farage's vanity project." Their withdrawal leaves **Count Binface** as the media-described "main challenger."

**Running against Farage:** The 34-candidate field includes Farage (Reform UK), Count Binface, Laurence Fox (The Reclaim Party), William Clouston (SDP), three Official Monster Raving Loony Party candidates, John Stevens (Rejoin EU), and roughly 19 Independents — full table provided above.

**Context:** Farage won Clacton in 2024 with 46.2% and an 8,405 majority. No constituency-level by-election polls existed as of the research date, though national polling showed majorities opposing the by-election and doubting Farage's honesty about his finances.

Full candidate list, party stances, and key dates are in the report above, with structured data submitted.

key_facts: Clacton by-election is set for Thursday 13 August 2026, triggered by Nigel Farage's resignation (announced 7 July 2026, accepted 8 July 2026).
A record 34 candidates are standing, the most in any UK parliamentary election in history (Statement of Persons Nominated confirmed 17 July 2026).
Five parties are standing aside/boycotting: Labour, Conservative Party, Liberal Democrats, Green Party, and Restore Britain.
Count Binface (novelty candidate) is widely described in media as Farage's main challenger due to the major-party boycott.
The by-election followed parliamentary scrutiny of Farage's finances, reportedly a £5m payment from crypto investor Christopher Harborne allegedly not properly declared; Farage denies wrongdoing.

Nigel Farage stands for Reform UK; other named party candidates include Laurence Fox (The Reclaim Party), William Clouston (Social Democratic Party), and three Official Monster Raving Loony Party candidates.
Roughly 19 of the 34 candidates are Independents.
In 2024, Farage won Clacton with 46.2% of the vote, a majority of 8,405 (18.3 points), on 58.7% turnout.
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch called it a 'fake by-election' / 'ego by-election'; Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it 'Farage's vanity project.'
No constituency-level by-election polls had been published as of the research date; national polls (YouGov, Ipsos, Opinium) show majority opposition to the by-election.
